title: MissionNav2
description: One nav2 NavigateToPose goal's lifecycle, watched passively: a mission_start Record when it is accepted, a mission_end Record when it reaches a terminal state. The base Record contract every Mission Measurement nav2 adapter shares (NavigateThroughPoses, FollowWaypoints)

mission_type.description: Always 'navigate_to_pose' for this adapter -- other Mission Measurement adapters set their own value

recoveries.description: NavigateToPose::Feedback.number_of_recoveries at mission completion, when feedback was seen before the terminal state
